Description: You found the self-hosted website of your neighbor and noticed that it is a crypto wallet. Use basic web knowledge to get access to their wallet.
Hint1: You can use web tools to view the HTML source code.
Hint2: Web tools provide a function to inspect the web storage.
Hint3: The web storage function allows you to see the content of all saved cookies.

Description: You are on a news webpage but want to access information that is not easily available through the search function.
Hint1: You can do something special with the search function.
Hint2: Maybe the website uses a database in the backend. Did the developer secure it properly?
Hint3: Consider trying an SQL injection.

Description: This is a new website created by some students from HTL Mössingerstraße. Use a tool to find a hidden file. The file contains some information about crypto; take a good look.
Hint1: The student provides more on their website than you might think.
Hint2: There may be hidden files; try changing the URL.
Hint3: You can use FUZZ to find hidden files.

Description: This is a new website created by some students from HTL Mössingerstraße. Use a tool to find a hidden file. The file contains some information about crypto; take a good look. Some other information might help you assemble the flag.
Hint1: The student provides more on their website than you might think.
Hint2: There may be hidden files; try changing the URL.
Hint3: The student manipulated the IDs. Another number may provide additional information.

Description: A hacker displays a photo of himself on his page. Find some special information.
Hint1: You might take a closer look at the image.
Hint2: Have you tried using EXIF tools already?
Hint3: You can use a web tool to view the metadata.

Description: You have a special project. Maybe you can figure out what this file does.
Hint1: The script is written in Brainfuck.
Hint2: The script might be broken.
Hint3: The script is broken. Try to fix it on your own :).

Description: In this challenge, you were tasked to find the flag within a picture. Good luck!
Hint1: Every file has a story to tell; some just need the right tool to read them.
Hint2: Information can be stored where you least expect it—try checking the metadata.
Hint3: Comments aren’t just for conversations; sometimes, they hide secrets.

Description: Your mission is to uncover the first flag hidden within information related to Tanja Alina Weiss. Somewhere in the details provided, a flag is subtly concealed. The flag could appear in unexpected places, so stay sharp!
Hint1: A profile can hold more than just pictures; connections matter.
Hint2: Tags can tell a story—follow them to uncover the next clue.
Hint3: Sometimes, the most important details aren’t in the image itself but in what’s linked to it.

Description: Identify the destination that Tanja considers her most favorite place she has visited so far.
Hint1: People often share their favorite spots, but you might have to read between the lines.
Hint2: A favorite place is worth mentioning; find where it’s written.
Hint3: Comments can be just as revealing as posts—look closely at what’s being said.

Description: Uncover her birthday. The answer may require careful deduction and attention to detail. Submit your findings in the format FF{DD-MM-YYYY}.
Hint1: A username is more than just a name—it might hold important numbers.
Hint2: The bio can reveal more than you think; age is just a clue to the bigger picture.
Hint3: Connect the dots.

Description: The time traveler’s first clue is hidden in plain sight on their old blog. The blog was hosted at www.faketimemachine.rf.gd, but it has since vanished. Use your time machine to recover their lost notes and find the first piece of the time capsule.
Hint1: Maybe you can find any kind archive in the internet?
Hint2: Your time machine is named archive.org ...
Hint3: Have a better look at the source.

Description: Great work, traveler! You’ve found the first piece of the time capsule. But the next clue is more subtle. The second flag is hidden deeper within the echoes of the blog—inspect it carefully.
Hint1: Maybe you can find some images, that aren't that easy to access.
Hint2: Have a look at the hidden directories.
Hint3: dirbuster is a great tool.

Description: You’re almost there! The third and final piece of the time capsule requires your problem-solving skills.
Hint1: There should be other files than the images.
Hint2: Everyone knows Jack the Ripper.
Hint3: There are a lot of simple tools to find something.

Description: The infamous PhantomCoder0916 has been hiding encrypted messages in their Git repository, PhantomCode. Your mission is to track down and uncover these secrets before they disappear forever. Each clue brings you closer to understanding what PhantomCoder0916 is up to. A strange commit appeared in the PhantomCode repository. Rumors say it contains a secret message, but it's buried among countless fake commits. Can you find what PhantomCoder0916 was trying to communicate?
Hint1: Sometimes, the answer is hiding in plain sight.
Hint2: Small details can make a big difference.
Hint3: Search commit messages carefully—one of them hides the truth.

Description: A crucial file once existed in the repository but was mysteriously deleted. What was in it? Why did PhantomCoder0916 erase it? Your task is to retrieve what was lost before it's gone for good.
Hint1: Don’t overthink it—sometimes the simplest answer is the right one.
Hint2: A simple search can reveal more than you think.
Hint3: Look through the commit history to find traces of the missing file.

Description: Not all secrets are erased—some are cleverly hidden in plain sight. PhantomCoder0916 has been marking important milestones in the repository, but one of these marks conceals something unusual. Can you find the hidden message?
Hint1: Git doesn't only consists of commits and their history.
Hint2: Try harder!
Hint3: Examine the tags carefully. One of them contains a secret.

Description: Someone has been tampering with the repository—an unknown user who shouldn’t have access. But who is it? PhantomCoder0916 may have created a fake identity to cover their tracks. Find the imposter and expose their email address to uncover the final piece of the puzzle. Submit your findings in the format FF{email-address}
Hint1: Try different approaches; there's more than one way to solve a problem.
Hint2: Ask yourself: ‘What would a beginner miss?’
Hint3: Investigate the commit authors. One of them doesn’t belong.

Description: We have found an endpoint that prints some strange data. According to some captured documentation this endpoint contains the password of a administrative account. As always, the password is in the format FF{somelongstring}
Hint1: Maybe the data is not in a human readable format.
Hint2: Characters can be represented in binary.
Hint3: Maybe it is not just one whole string as output, but two

Description: Our security experts gathered an invoice during an investigation. It is believed that there is hidden information in the mentioned document - can you find it?
Hint1: Honestly, its not that hard!
Hint2: Do you really think you have inspected the document completely?
Hint3: Which color cannot be seen on a white background?

Description: Our security experts gathered an invoice during an investigation. It is believed that there is hidden information in the mentioned document - can you find it?
Hint1: Honestly, what do you expect of a PDF?
Hint2: Do you really think you have inspected the document completely?
Hint3: Is this the only file you downloaded?

Description: A simple image can hide more than just colors and pixels. Your task is to uncover the secrets buried within. Dig deep, extract what’s hidden, and listen carefully—you might see the answer.
Hint1: Not everything in a file is visible at first glance. Sometimes, reading between the lines helps.
Hint2: Sounds can reveal secrets in unexpected ways—try looking at them instead of just listening.
Hint3: The key is already there, just waiting to be read. The last few words might be your way in.

Description: We have intercepted a string from 100BC with an unknown alien encryption technology. Try to solve it
Hint1: Check the name of the challenge.
Hint2: Maybe try ChatGPT.
Hint3: Man this should be easy.

Description: We got a string of characters, but some letters seem to have been modified. Find it out.
Hint1: Checksums are a funny thing.
Hint2: How can text be encoded?
Hint3: ord()

Description: A weird script has been found, it seems to run but it doesn't look very readable
Hint1: Try giving the code names.
Hint2: Cryptography is hard.
Hint3: The key is hidden in plain sight.

Description: During a investigation, a file has been found potentially including crucial information. Sadly the file is unable to be opened, we suspect it may be corrupted
Hint1: What a weird file, maybe take a look at it more closely at the hexadecimal.
Hint2: Compression tends to mangle data.
Hint3: Maybe instead of being corrupted, some information may have just been lost.

Description: A seemingly simple zip archive hides a secret, but it's buried deep... really deep. Can you unravel the onion and reach the core?
Hint1: Consider how to handle tasks that repeat.
Hint2: Time is a factor.
Hint3: There are tools that can help with complex archiving tasks... Scripts

Description: You have intercepted a mysterious WAV audio file. The transmission seems encoded, but you may have heared something like this before. Can you decode the message hidden within?
Hint1: The signal is not just noise, think about how images can be sent over radio waves.
Hint2: Some amateur radio enthusiasts might recognize this type of transmission. Try searching for ways to decode images from sound.
Hint3: Think of old-school analog TV signals, but much slower...

Description: We've intercepted a mysterious transmission, but something seems off. A message can be clearly heard, but is it telling the whole truth? We think there is another message hidden together with the obvious one. Can you find out whrer that message is and retreive it? (Flags follow the FF{abc123} format, please note that letters have to be lowercase!
Hint1: One message is loud, but the real one is much quieter.
Hint2: Check frequencies above the audible range.
Hint3: A spectrogram will help you see what you can not hear.

Description: We've hidden the secret within a Python file, but the source code is nowhere to be found! Your task is to decompile the .pyc file and analyze its logic to figure out how the flag is stored in a separate file. Can you reverse-engineer the code and retrieve the flag?
Hint1: Python files can be compiled from .py files to .pyc. Maybe you can reverse this process?
Hint2: Some tools, like pycdc, might help you reconstruct the original source code.
Hint3: Finding the decompiled code is just the first step. Look at how it interacts with external files to locate the flag!

Description: Are you the Decryption Master that can find interesting information, hidden on the Linux system? IMPORTANT! Use the link provided in order to access the system via SSH (port 80)!
Hint1: Honestly, its not that hard!
Hint2: Think, what do you want to know about the system in the first place?
Hint3: Start off with some basic commands to get an overview of the system.

Description: Are you the Decryption Master that can find interesting information, hidden on the Linux system? IMPORTANT! Use the link provided in order to access the system via SSH (port 80)!
Hint1: Honestly, its not that hard!
Hint2: Inspect interesting files on the system.
Hint3: Numbers never lie.

Description: Prof. Schmidt’s coordinates to his favourite holiday destination were stolen. Unfortunately, he separated them into three pieces (due to security policies) which makes finding them quite difficult. However, the thief left some hints about their locations. Now it's your turn to find them! (The student's favourite eating location; This place is quite interesting, but sadly, experiments are rather rare; 'Das ist aber SCHADE!'

Hint2: SYT: URI model | Maths: Length of an unknown side is needed
Hint3: SYT: First R, then I | Maths: Sinus and cosine rule may help
